_docs.config: Copy this file to client/config.json (untracked/local). Relative paths (queue_file, results_file) resolve against the client/ package dir — e.g. '../data/queue.jsonl' → <repo>/data/queue.jsonl.
_docs.executor: Command template run via bash -c. Placeholders: {payload_file}, {result_file}, and {repo} — expanded to the TRUE idlefill repo root in both layouts (dev: tsx client/src/index.ts; packaged: client/dist), so 'node {repo}/adapters/career-ops/eval.mjs …' finds the adapter at <repo>/adapters/career-ops/eval.mjs. At startup the client checks the expanded script path exists and refuses to request leases (staying registered/online-but-inactive, FATAL in the log) if it is missing — a broken executor template must not burn job attempts.
_docs.adapter: Alternative to hand-writing 'executor' (issue #13): name a registered adapter (e.g. "career-ops", "noop") and the client resolves the executor template, payload_fields, estimated_seconds, and timeout_seconds from its manifest at <repo>/adapters/<name>/package.json (the "idlefill" key). Precedence: an explicit 'executor' here wins over the manifest; an unknown adapter name is FATAL at startup (same online-but-inactive posture as a missing script). cwd stays config-only — it is machine-specific, never manifest material.
_docs.update_channel: Menu bar app only. Absent/empty = the releases channel (the default — the newest published release). A branch name = the branch channel: the check tracks that branch's tip edge build (edge-<branch>-<sha7>). Read once at launch; a relaunch picks up a change.
_docs.update_pin: Menu bar app only, opt-in within the branch channel. A commit SHA (7–40 hex): the check targets the PINNED commit's edge build instead of the branch's tip. Malformed/empty = absent (tip-following). Ignored on the releases channel.
_docs.update_check_minutes: Menu bar app only. The automatic update-check cadence in minutes (default 360 = 6h; clamped to a minimum of 5 — a lower value is clamped up and the clamp is logged once at launch to logs/idlefill-menubar.log). Absent/empty/invalid = the default. Read once at launch; a relaunch picks up a new value.
